utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: It’s moved to Sunday at the community center now. I can help—just tell me what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Ira. We still need a few people to sort supplies and help set up, and I’ll let you know if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, it’s on Sunday now, at the community center. I’m a little fuzzy on the details, but I can check and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, just let me know what still needs doing when you check.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still happening today, right?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Actually, it’s moved to Sunday at the community center, not today. I’m still sorting the remaining tasks and will share what’s left shortly.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: It’s moved to Sunday at the community center now. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m glad it’s set, but I’d like to pin down the top priorities first — what do we still need most for Sunday?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sunday at the community center works for me. I’ll keep it simple and plan around school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sunday at the community center sounds good—thanks, Faye. I’ll be there and help keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—let me know the plan for Sunday at the community center, and I’ll be ready then.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s still on—just not today. We moved the repair drive to Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s now on Sunday at the community center. Thanks for helping out—I’ll spread the word and bring a few tools and supplies.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, I’ll be there on Sunday at the community center. What time should I come?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me what still needs doing and where the repair drive is headed? I want to make sure I have the details right before I help out.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m still taking stock of what we’re short on, but I’ll tell you the top priorities for the repair drive soon.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and rally a few more neighbors. Just send me the time and place, and I’ll get it moving.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I still don’t have the exact time yet, but I’ll check and get back to you. The repair drive is at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Not much else yet — we’re still getting the repair drive details together. I can fill you in as soon as we know more.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Sam — I’m happy to wait for the update. Just let me know when the details are set, and I’ll help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand and a few tools for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need most.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Gus — do you know what tools would help most, or should I just bring whatever I’ve got?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yes, Saturday morning at the community center on Oak Street first — please spread the word, and I’ll keep an ear out for what’s needed most.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — Saturday morning at the community center on Oak Street. I’ll keep tracking the locations and spread the word.
